NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, November 11 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, November 11 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 11, 6:44 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, November 11 DraftKings main slate at 62.0 DraftKings points for $12,300. Nikola Jokic (DEN, 61.9, $11,500) and Victor Wembanyama (SAS, 58.3, $11,800) are next.

Day'Ron Sharpe (BKN) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.89 projected points per $1,000 at $5,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 11, 6:44 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
